query: Which statistical tests and representation metrics (KS, Hausdorff, Dice, Fréchet distances) best quantify fidelity of physics-informed synthetic lesions versus real lesions?

response.query: Which statistical tests and representation metrics (KS, Hausdorff, Dice, Fréchet distances) best quantify fidelity of physics-informed synthetic lesions versus real lesions?
response.answer: The Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) and Fréchet distances are best for quantitative fidelity, while Dice and Hausdorff metrics also provide useful comparisons for synthetic versus real lesions.
